domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains columns typical of e-commerce retail transactions: InvoiceNo (transaction identifier), StockCode and Description (product details), Quantity and UnitPrice (order line items), InvoiceDate (transaction timestamp), CustomerID (buyer identifier), and Country (geographic market). The presence of these fields strongly suggests a retail sales domain.

kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of all sales (Quantity * UnitPrice) across the dataset, representing the business's gross revenue.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is a fundamental KPI for retail businesses, providing a single summary metric of overall sales performance. A 'card' visual is ideal for displaying this single value.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Sum of revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) grouped by Country, identifying top revenue markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Revenue by country is critical for understanding geographic performance. The low cardinality of Country (38 distinct values) makes it well-suited for a bar chart comparison.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Sum of revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) grouped by month, showing sales trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Tracking revenue over time is essential for identifying seasonal patterns or growth trends. A line chart effectively visualizes temporal trends.

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Average revenue per invoice, calculated as total revenue divided by the number of unique invoices.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS average_order_value FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: AOV is a key retail metric for understanding customer spending behavior. A 'card' visual is appropriate for this single summary value.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Products by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) for each product, ranked to show the highest-grossing items.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Description, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Description ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: Identifying top-performing products helps prioritize inventory and marketing efforts. A bar chart effectively ranks the top 10 products by revenue.
